items.headline: Sandusky withdraws recantation claim, seeks higher court trial
items.description: Jerry Sandusky appeared in Centre County Court on Tuesday via video conference to withdraw his claim there for an appeal, which included a recantation witness, in hopes of taking his effort for a new trial to a higher court.
